modbusProxy.title: Modbus TCP Proxy Server
modbusProxy.description: Optional multi-client Modbus TCP proxy. Clients connect to this Homebridge host and the configured listen port; requests are serialized over one shared target connection.

targetHost.title: Target IP Address or Hostname
targetHost.description: Modbus TCP device receiving the forwarded requests.

listenHost.title: Listen Address
listenHost.description: Use 0.0.0.0 to accept clients on every Homebridge network interface.

listenPort.title: Proxy Listen Port
listenPort.description: Port used by Wallbox, energy management and other Modbus TCP clients.

solarEdge.title: SolarEdge Plant Monitoring
solarEdge.description: Optional persistent monitoring for a multi-inverter SolarEdge plant. Remove this section to disable monitoring.

unitIds.title: Inverter Unit IDs
unitIds.description: Modbus unit IDs of all SolarEdge inverters in this plant.

meterUnitId.title: Meter Unit ID
meterUnitId.description: Inverter unit containing SunSpec Meter Model 203.

pollIntervalMs.title: Polling Interval
pollIntervalMs.description: Time between complete plant snapshots in milliseconds.

meterConsistencyThresholdWatts.title: Meter Consistency Threshold
meterConsistencyThresholdWatts.description: Maximum permitted meter power change while a sequential plant snapshot is read.

snapshotRetryCount.title: Snapshot Retries
snapshotRetryCount.description: Immediate retries after an inconsistent plant snapshot.
